# Packages

**[Regress.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/Regress.jl)** | High-performance linear models with fixed effects and instrumental variables

**[Siphon.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/Siphon.jl)** | Linear state space models: Kalman filtering, smoothing, and estimation

**[CovarianceMatrices.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/CovarianceMatrices.jl)** | HAC Covariance Matrix Estimation

**[Factotum.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/Factotum.jl)** | Static factor models: PCA, EM, and iterative least squares, with missing data and information criteria

**[LocalProjections.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/LocalProjections.jl)** | Local projection impulse responses (experimental)

**[MacroEconometricTools.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/MacroEconometricTools.jl)** | VAR estimation, structural identification, and impulse responses

**[ModelSummaries.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/ModelSummaries.jl)** | Publication-quality regression tables

**[Divergences.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/Divergences.jl)** | Fast evaluation of divergences

**[Hermetic.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/Hermetic.jl)** | Multivariate standard and Hermitian polynomials

**[BayesianTools.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/BayesianTools.jl)** | Utilities for Monte Carlo Markov Chain simulations

**[Genoud.jl](https://github.com/gragusa/Genoud.jl)** | Genetic optimization using derivatives
